rows.label: Processeurs / socket
rows.value: Supports AMD Ryzen™ 9000/ 8000/ 7000 Series Desktop ProcessorsSocket AM5

rows.label: Mémoire
rows.value:
4x DDR5 UDIMM, Maximum Memory Capacity 256GBMemory Support DDR5 8200 - 5600 (OC) MT/s / 5600 - 4800 (JEDEC) MT/sRyzen™ 9000 Series Processors max. overclocking frequency:

• 1DPC 1R Max speed up to 8200+ MT/s

• 1DPC 2R Max speed up to 6400+ MT/s

• 2DPC 1R Max speed up to 6400+ MT/s

• 2DPC 2R Max speed up to 6000+ MT/s
Supports AMD POR Speed and JEDEC Speed

Supports Memory Overclocking and AMD EXPOTM

Supports Dual-Channel mode

Supports Non-ECC, Un-buffered memory

Supports CUDIMM, Clock Driver bypass mode only*



* CUDIMM support and POR boot frequency may vary by CPU series, with manual overclocking available after boot. Certain CPUs may fail to boot, but future BIOS updates will improve compatibility.

• Memory compatibility and supported speeds can vary depending on the CPU and memory configuration. For detailed information, please refer to the Memory Compatibility List available on the product’s Support page or visit https://www.msi.com/support/.

rows.label: Onboard Graphics
rows.value: 1x DisplayPortSupport DisplayPort 1.2, maximum resolution of 4K 60Hz**Available only on processors featuring integrated graphics. Graphics specifications may vary depending on the CPU installed.

rows.label: PCIe et restrictions
rows.value:
4x PCI-E x16 slotPCI_E1 Gen PCIe 5.0 supports up to x16 (From CPU) PCI_E2 Gen PCIe 3.0 supports up to x1 (From Chipset) PCI_E3 Gen PCIe 4.0 supports up to x4 (From Chipset) PCI_E4 Gen PCIe 3.0 supports up to x1 (From Chipset) 

PCI_E1 slot

• Supports PCIe 5.0 x16 (For Ryzen™ 9000/ 7000 Series processors)

• Supports PCIe 4.0 x8 (For Ryzen™ 8700/ 8600/ 8400 Series processors)

• Supports PCIe 4.0 x4 (For Ryzen™ 8500/ 8300 Series processor)



* PCI_E2, PCI_E3 & PCI_E4 share the bandwidth, PCI_E3 slot will run at x2 speed when installing devices in the PCI_E2 or PCI_E4 slot.

rows.value:
3x M.2M.2_1 Source (From CPU) supports up to PCIe 5.0 x4 , supports 2280/2260 devices M.2_2 Source (From CPU) supports up to PCIe 4.0 x4 , supports 22110/2280 devices M.2_3 Source (From Chipset) supports up to PCIe 4.0 x2 , supports 2280/2260 devices 4x SATA 6G

M2_1 slot

• Supports up to PCIe 5.0 x4 (For Ryzen™ 9000/ 7000 Series processors)

• Supports up to PCIe 4.0 x4 (For Ryzen™ 8000 Series processors)



*Please refer to the manual for M.2 SSD heatsink restrictions.

notes: Le nom de modèle identifie la carte mère. Le fabricant ne fournit pas ici de référence commerciale de lot/PCB ; aucune révision de vente ni offre marchande nouvelle n’est supposée.
Sections techniques publiées pour le modèle exact. Les champs absents restent inconnus. Aucun numéro de lot/révision non publié ni prix n’est déduit du nom de modèle.
Les restrictions CPU/BIOS, partage PCIe/M.2, limites de mémoire et conditions de connectique sont conservées dans le texte officiel.
Le compteur M.2 ne retient que les sockets de stockage explicitement PCIe/NVMe ; les sockets Wi-Fi Key E et SATA seuls sont exclus.
